items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP; TE Elijah Arroyo undergoing shoulder surgery, out for season.
items.why: Charbonnet from PUP significant; Arroyo season-ending.
items.implication: Charbonnet immediate backfield role vs KC; TE targets redistribute.

items.text: Bears ruled out RB Kyle Monangai for TNF vs Patriots; misses third straight with thumb/turf toe.
items.implication: Bears RB depth elevated for TNF; D'Andre Swift/others more snaps.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson recovery will take some time and is not expected ready next week; biggest Adams injury beneficiary delayed. Rams only answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Adams ruptured hamstring out 6-10 weeks; Ferguson IR delay leaves Nacua as primary option.
items.implication: Puka massive target spike ROS/Week 7 vs LV.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice second straight day due to hamstring.
items.implication: Danger of missing another game; Worthy/others elevated.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice Thursday after prior DNP with quad.
items.why: Returned to practice per Jets report.
items.implication: Increasing chance to play vs MIA; monitor Friday.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed team meetings, lifting, medicals, non-football activities at facility. MarShawn Lloyd 49th EPA/rush, Kaleb Johnson 53rd among 54; OL mess too.
items.why: Facility access positive long-term; backups inefficient.
items.implication: Jacobs ROS viable once back; avoid Lloyd/Johnson.

items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice (ankle); limited Wed.
items.implication: Promising for potential return vs CIN.
items.opportunity: QB1 upside if active; Flowers/Andrews boost

items.text: Saquon Barkley “in line” to play Monday vs DAL (Berry RB15); efficient in prior full games. Expected return to practice.
items.why: Sources expect practice return and play; Dallas soft vs RBs.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10); Bears good for yardage, Brown back in real role.
Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11); elite volume.
Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6), Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12); workloads + friendly matchups (Lions buffet for pass-catchers, run defenses carved).

Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32), Josh Downs @ MIN (WR41), Travis Kelce @ SEA (TE9), Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18), Cam Skattebo @ HOU (RB37); nasty matchups, role issues, workload questions post-layoff, brutal spots.
items.conflict: Jacobs facility access positive per Levitan but Berry workload concern

items.text: Week 7 Snaps & Pace: Up in pace TB@CAR, GB@DET, LAR@LV. Slow slogs MIA@NYJ, SF@ATL, IND@MIN. High volume/explosive spots preferred.
Giants start JJ McCarthy vs HOU. Yards per target to Justin Jefferson: McCarthy 5.7 vs Mullens 10.8/Cousins 10.5/Darnold 10.0/Wentz 9.9. Different scheme/coaches/small sample but concerning.
items.opportunity: targets still high but YAC/efficiency down
